editorial:
Four mutant turtles with ninja skills step out of the sewers to save New York from a dangerous crime boss. You follow Leonardo, Raphael, Michelangelo, and Donatello as they team up with a brave reporter named April O'Neil. The vibe is loud, colorful, and packed with action. It feels like a big summer blockbuster made for fans of comic book heroes. You get plenty of jokes, fast fights, and a city that looks great on screen. The turtles each have their own personality, so you always know who is who. It is not deep, but it is fun and easy to watch with friends or family.

The action scenes are the real highlight, with big set pieces that keep you on the edge of your seat. The pacing moves fast, so you never get bored. Acting is solid, especially the voice work for the turtles, though some human characters feel a bit flat. On the downside, the story is pretty simple and some jokes miss the mark. Still, if you want a fun popcorn movie, this delivers. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray.
endingExplained: In the final battle, the turtles fight the Shredder on a rooftop while April and her cameraman try to stop a toxic gas from spreading across the city. The Shredder is defeated and falls from the tower. The turtles save the day and return to the shadows, keeping their secret safe. April keeps their story to herself, and the city is safe once again. The movie ends with the turtles celebrating their victory back in the sewers.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves action-packed comic book adventures and lighthearted fun.
